title: Preflight Approval Artifact
description: A separate, attributable artifact that upgrades a REQUIRE_APPROVAL decision to ALLOW. Signed with a DISTINCT approver key the producer/authoring agent does not hold, so it cannot be self-minted. Bound to the exact intentId + commitSha it approves and to a REQUIRE_APPROVAL->ALLOW grant, so it cannot be reused for a different intent, commit, or decision. Missing/invalid/expired/mismatched fails closed (the REQUIRE_APPROVAL stands).

intentId.description: The Action Intent id this approval is bound to.

commitSha.description: The 40-hex commit the approval is bound to.

grants.description: The decision this approval grants. v0.1: only ALLOW.

forDecision.description: The originating decision being upgraded. v0.1: only REQUIRE_APPROVAL.

attestation.description: Integrity envelope, signed with the DISTINCT approver key.
